$comment: UCOS-UCAF-001 — UNIVERSAL CONSTITUTIONAL AUTHORITY FRAMEWORK (declaration). This file is
DATA and is the ONLY place this programme's capability set, authority SOURCES, tier source,
delegation sources, succession sources, scope rules, resolution questions, reconciliations,
reference surfaces, validation dimensions and exit criteria are stated. ucaf_engine.py
contains no authority identifier, no tier identifier, no vacancy identifier, no resolution
answer and no source token: everything it registers, resolves, validates and certifies is
read from here and from the LOCATED instruments named here.
KNOWLEDGE ONCE — WHY NO AUTHORITY IS DEFINED IN THIS FILE. The repository already defines
its authorities. 01-WORKING/AUTHORITY-REGISTER.md defines the authority and governance
constructs extracted from 00-SOURCE/ with traceability; each 00-CEP instrument defines its
own instrument authority in its ARTICLE I; 00-CMG/CMG-REGISTRY.json declares the tier
lattice, the tier occupancies and the recorded vacancies. This programme RESTATES none of
them. It declares WHERE they live and HOW to read them, and DISCOVERS the authorities at
run time. An authority added to a located register is therefore discovered here
automatically; an authority referenced anywhere but defined nowhere is surfaced as an
UNDEFINED AUTHORITY rather than silently accepted.
WHAT THIS PROGRAMME ADDS, AND WHY IT IS NOT A PARALLEL AUTHORITY. It creates no authority,
confers no authority, ratifies nothing, certifies no artifact and occupies no tier. Its
authority is NONE (DERIVED TRUTH). What no located programme owned is the AUTHORITY MODEL
ITSELF as machine-readable, resolvable, validated structure: before this programme every
authority in the repository existed only as prose, so no gate could resolve a competence
question, no gate could detect an authority referenced but never defined, and no gate could
detect that a recorded vacancy had been contradicted by later located evidence. This
programme is that model and only that model.
WHAT THIS PROGRAMME DELIBERATELY DOES NOT DO. It does not close a vacancy. It does not
promote a lower instrument into a vacant tier (00-CMG/CMG-000001 XVII.4 forbids it, and
LXXXI.5 voids any reading that does). It does not decide a conflict between two located
instruments: where a recorded claim of authority absence and later located evidence of
authority presence both stand, this programme MEASURES both, cites both, and reports a
RECONCILIATION-REQUIRED outcome for the claim owner to dispose of under CEP-002 Article 23.
It never converts a measured reconciliation into a ratification.

programme.name: Universal Constitutional Authority Framework
programme.authority: NONE — DERIVED TRUTH. This programme creates no authority, confers no authority, occupies no tier and ratifies nothing. It reads the located instruments that define the repository's authorities and reports what they say.
programme.disclosure: **DISCLOSURE.** CERTIFIED-PROVISIONAL. This programme holds no ratification authority and no constitutional authority: it registers, resolves, validates and audits the authorities the repository has already located. Where this register and a located instrument differ, the located instrument governs.

$capability_comment: The eleven capabilities the authority model must exhibit. Each names the measure that
discharges it. A capability whose measure does not run is reported UNDISCHARGED and fails
closed: absence of a measurement is never evidence of a capability.

capabilities.obligation: every authority the repository defines is registered as an addressable record derived from its located definition
every located delegation of a concern to an owner is registered, and its owner resolves
every declared competence question resolves to an answer read out of a located instrument, or is reported UNRESOLVED
every declared validation dimension is measured, and a declared dimension with no measurement fails closed
every located supersession determination over an authoritative source is registered and its source tokens resolve
every declared scope rule binds to a located clause, and the clause text is verified present
every registered record is verified against the located file it was derived from, by path existence and content digest
every registered authority carries at least one evidence pointer that resolves in the repository
the registry emits an append-only, content-addressed audit ledger sufficient to reconstruct the registration deterministically
the revocation channel exists, is append-only, and every entry names a resolving authority and an existing record — per CEP-002 13.5 a revocation takes effect upon record
no authority remains undefined: every authority-shaped reference in the declared surfaces resolves to a registered authority

$source_comment: Authority sources. Each entry says WHERE authorities are defined and HOW to read them.
format markdown-table  — a pipe table in a markdown file, optionally under a heading.
format article-authority — an ARTICLE I heading of the form '## ARTICLE I — <NAME> AUTHORITY'
across a glob of instruments; the instrument IS the definition.
The engine holds no member of any of these families as a literal.

authority_sources.name: Located authority constructs
authority_sources.basis: 01-WORKING/AUTHORITY-REGISTER.md PART A — every construct extracted from 00-SOURCE/ with traceability; 'No construct invented.'

authority_sources.name: Located governance constructs
authority_sources.basis: 01-WORKING/AUTHORITY-REGISTER.md PART B — governance constructs including the ratification decision + audit procedure and the self-amendment procedure.

authority_sources.name: Instrument authorities declared by the constitutional programme
authority_sources.basis: Each 00-CEP instrument defines its own authority in its ARTICLE I. The instrument is both the definition and the evidence.

$source_token_comment: Source-token registers. A located authority names its sources by token. A token that
resolves in one of these registers, or to an existing repository path, is EVIDENCE; a token
that resolves nowhere is an unresolved evidence pointer and a validation failure.
$tier_comment: The tier lattice is NOT declared here. It is read from the located meta-constitutional
projection, which is its canonical machine-readable home. Occupancy and vacancy are read
from the same place, so a vacancy closed by its owner is observed here automatically.

tier_source.basis: 00-CMG/CMG-000001 ARTICLE XVI (authority hierarchy) and ARTICLE XVII.4 (resolution reaching a vacant tier), projected as data in 00-CMG/CMG-REGISTRY.json.

$delegation_comment: Delegation. CEP-002 Article 13 legislates the delegation model and Article 14 the canonical
ownership of a concern. The located meta-constitutional projection already records the
concern-to-owner allocations; this programme registers them and checks that each named
owner resolves to a located instrument or path.
$succession_comment: Succession. Authority succession in this repository is recorded as supersession of the
authoritative source for a concept. The located supersession register is that record.
$revocation_comment: Revocation. CEP-002 13.5: revocation of a delegation SHALL be recorded and SHALL take
effect upon record. The channel is append-only and is EMPTY: no revocation has been
recorded in this repository. An empty channel is not an absent channel — every entry
appended here is validated against the registry, so a future revocation cannot be recorded
against an authority that does not exist.
$scope_comment: Scope. Rather than restating each authority's limits, this programme binds the located
clauses that bound ALL authority and verifies the clause text is present in the located
instrument. A rule whose anchor is absent is a binding failure, not a silent pass.

scope_rules.rule: authority must be explicit, traceable, auditable, governed, revocable and bounded; no action without authority; no authority beyond jurisdiction
scope_rules.anchor: Authority must be explicit, traceable, auditable, governed, revocable, bounded

scope_rules.rule: sovereignty cannot be assumed, fabricated or bypassed; delegation does not transfer sovereignty
scope_rules.anchor: Sovereignty cannot be assumed, fabricated, or bypassed

scope_rules.rule: governance shall never self-elevate and shall never create a governance power not established by its instrument
governance shall not assert, simulate or substitute for constitutional authority
scope_rules.anchor: Governance SHALL NOT assert, simulate, or substitute for Constitutional Authority

scope_rules.rule: delegation flows only downward, is bounded, recorded and revocable, and never exceeds the delegator's own power
scope_rules.anchor: Revocation of a delegation SHALL be recorded and SHALL take effect upon record

scope_rules.rule: ratification authority shall never be self-conferred by execution authority and acts only upon an authorization
scope_rules.anchor: SHALL NEVER be self-conferred by Execution Authority

scope_rules.rule: where finality requires an authority outside the corpus, that authority is superior for finality and in-corpus ratification confers only PROVISIONAL acceptance
scope_rules.anchor: Ratification Authority within the corpus SHALL confer only PROVISIONAL acceptance

scope_rules.rule: resolution reaching a vacant tier shall not skip the tier and shall not promote a lower instrument into it
scope_rules.anchor: SHALL NOT skip the tier and SHALL NOT promote a lower instrument into it

scope_rules.rule: a steward shall not confer authority, decide constitutional content, or exceed delegated bounds
freeze authority shall never be self-conferred by execution authority and preserves only
scope_rules.anchor: Freeze Authority SHALL NEVER be self-conferred by Execution Authority

$resolution_comment: Resolution. A competence question is answered by READING a located instrument, never by
this programme deciding. Each question names the instrument and the clause text that
carries the answer. The engine verifies the anchor is present and extracts the answering
identifier from the anchor's line using the discovered identifier families. If the anchor
is absent the question is reported UNRESOLVED — it is never answered by default.
in_corpus false means the located instrument itself places the answer outside the corpus;
the resolution then records an out-of-corpus superior rather than an in-corpus identifier.

$reconciliation_comment: Reconciliation. Two located instruments may both stand and disagree. This programme neither
silences the earlier nor asserts the later: it verifies that the claim still stands in its
owner, verifies whether the candidate evidence exists in ITS owner, and reports an outcome.
RECONCILIATION-REQUIRED means both are located and the claim owner must dispose of the
conflict under CEP-002 Article 23. This programme performs no disposal.
A reconciliation is NEVER a ratification and NEVER closes a vacancy.

$findings_comment: Findings this programme discloses rather than resolves.

findings.title: The authority model was prose-only, so no gate could resolve a competence question
findings.note: Before this programme every authority in the repository existed only as a prose table or an article of an instrument. The tier lattice alone was machine-readable. Consequently no gate could resolve which authority was competent for an act, no gate could detect an authority referenced but never defined, and no gate could detect that a recorded claim of authority absence had been contradicted by later located evidence. Closed by deriving the registry from the located instruments rather than by authoring a second authority model.

findings.title: A recorded vacancy and later located evidence of authority both stand; the conflict is referred, not decided
findings.note: The meta-constitutional projection records a vacant constitutional tier on the evidence that no ratified normative artifact occupies it. Located instruments elsewhere record an exogenous constituent act that identified the sovereign seat, chartered a standing ratification organ, and fixed document supremacy. Both are Repository Truth. Deciding between them is reserved to the claim owner under CEP-002 Article 23; this programme measures both sides, cites both, and refers. It does not promote any instrument into the vacant tier, which CMG-000001 XVII.4 forbids and LXXXI.5 voids.

findings.title: Competence to ratify and the ratifying act are distinct, and only the first is closable by measurement
findings.note: This programme can prove from located evidence which authority is competent for an act. It cannot perform the act: CEP-006 I.5 provides that ratification authority is never self-conferred by execution authority and acts only upon an authorization, and CEP-006 I.4 caps any in-corpus determination at PROVISIONAL. Recording a ratification is therefore owned by the ratification registry, and conferring one is owned by the located authority — never by this engine.
